Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. Thank you for making time for our arranged portfolio review. Is this still a convenient time to speak privately?

Yes, office quite quiet now. Usually everybody looking for me, but today I managed to clear the paperwork early lah. I've closed the door, so we can talk without interruptions.

Thank you. Before we begin the review, I'll complete our usual identification checks.

Got my details here, no need to search around. My identification number is G six seven zero five seven three two N. My date of birth is the twenty-seventh of August nineteen eighty-two.

Thank you. How are your plans to spend more time away from the business coming along?

Slowly getting there lor. My family can handle the daily work, but I still have the habit of checking everything. Got some photography equipment sitting at home, hardly touched. Would be nice to get out and use it.

That sounds like a welcome change of pace. For future review calls, would you prefer that I continue arranging them during quieter business hours?

Telephone better for me lah. During the busy part of the day, got people coming in and out of my room. When things settle down, I can actually listen instead of trying to answer emails at the same time.

I'll note that contact preference. We can arrange future calls in advance rather than interrupting you unexpectedly. Would you like the routine correspondence to continue through your existing channel?

Keep the usual channel, less troublesome. No need to send copies to the office staff ah. I keep my personal banking correspondence separate from the business paperwork.

I'll retain the existing correspondence arrangements. We can now turn to the portfolio review; I have your account information available.

I've got my notes ready already. For this transaction, use my holding in Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding. The transaction currency, use Japanese yen please. Set the transaction amount at 100,000,000. The quantity is 10,000 units. Use a limit order, with the minimum sale price at 10,000 Japanese yen. Below that price, don't execute ah.

To confirm, your objective is to reduce market exposure and free up liquidity for anticipated personal spending. The equity holdings in Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund can fall when stock markets decline, while rising interest rates can reduce the value of its bond holdings. Those markets can decline together, so diversification may not protect the fund's value. Do you understand these risks, including that the fund's equity and bond holdings can decline together?

Yes, I understand. The shares and bonds can both fall at the same time, so spreading across them doesn't mean the fund is protected lah.

The transaction fee for this sale is 0.2% of the transaction value. You may lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and selling may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss when you reduce this holding?

Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses when reducing this holding. But I still want to keep to my minimum sale price, not sell at any price.

I recommend reducing your holding in Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund because that reduces exposure to equity and bond market fluctuations and releases funds for your personal spending. Setting a minimum sale price respects your preference for price discipline, although the sale may remain unexecuted if that price is unavailable.

Let me look through my notes a moment ah. I've put everything on paper instead of switching between screens.

Please confirm your final instruction: sell 10,000 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, with a transaction amount of 100,000,000 in Japanese yen, using a limit order at a minimum sale price of 10,000 Japanese yen. Is that your instruction, and may I submit it?

Yes, I confirm the final instruction exactly as you read it back. Please submit it. Nothing else to discuss today lah.

Thank you, Adrian Lim. I'll attend to the submission and keep the correspondence within your existing arrangements. Thank you for your time today.

Thanks, Rachel Tan. Timing today quite good. Now I can get back to the office work, then hopefully leave on time for a change. Speak again another day.
